midWindowContentChanges.rationale: The frozen treatment on this page is title, metaDescription, canonical and H1, and none of them changed. The directory previously described each tool a second time with no identity link to the tool's own page, so a crawler could not tell the two were the same thing. Recorded here so the CTR window is not later read as a clean single-variable period.
